pages.title: Light or heavy
pages.text: A light spacesuit protects from vacuum, but not from radiation. A heavy one also protects from radiation and pressure, so get it as soon as you can. You need the full set: helmet, chest, legs and boots.

pages.title: Modification Table
pages.text: Modules go into a suit at the table. First make an Assembly Machine and a Blank Module. Some are active and toggled with keys. Right now they are $(k:keybind.togglehelmet.name), $(k:keybind.togglechest.name), $(k:keybind.togglelegs.name), $(k:keybind.toggleboots.name).

pages.title: Modules: awareness
pages.text: $(li)Sensor Glasses: show ores and monsters.$(li)Night Vision.$(li)Water Breathing.$(li)Autofeeding.$(li)Electric Jetpack.$(li)Advanced Battery.

pages.title: Modules: movement
pages.text: $(li)Speed Boosters.$(li)High Jump.$(li)Bigger Step for climbing blocks.$(li)Gravity Force: easier walking on planets.$(li)$(l:space/planets/uranus#miranda)Cobalt$() Protection inserts.
